# devices-mcp
> Beta home IoT MCP + FastAPI/React dashboard + optional Windows Tauri installer. Three legs: MCP tools, webapp :10717/app/, desktop NSIS bundle.

## Docs
- [README](README.md): Overview, TOC, three delivery legs (not production-ready).
- [INSTALL](INSTALL.md): Tauri installer, MCPB, clone, NSSM.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): MCP + web-sota + Tauri sidecars.
- [Desktop](docs/DESKTOP.md): Installer, splash, NSSM coexistence.
- [Configuration](docs/CONFIGURATION.md): config.yaml, Vienna preset, discovery.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): Splash CORS, logs path.
- [Full corpus](llms-full.txt): Deep tool and env reference.

## Ports
- 10717: FastAPI backend + SPA /app/
- 10716: Vite dev only
- 10715: Camera sidecar (optional)

## Releases
- devices-mcp.mcpb (MCP leg)
- Devices-MCP-*-x64-setup.exe (desktop leg)
- Devices-MCP-*-windows-x64.zip (portable)
